stage0057_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
Altair Soldier
「Iron-C's operating rate has fallen below 40 percent.」

stage0057_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
Altair Soldier
「Above all, the energy cost of
　dimensional transfer is off the charts.」

stage0057_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
Altair Soldier
「Furthermore, Vega's dimensional boundary
　grows stronger by the day.」

stage0057_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$イズモ$$
「So opening a dimensional gate there
　costs more energy than expected...」

stage0057_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
Altair Soldier
「Keep shuttling to Vega any longer,
　and it strains Citizens' basic living,
　risking large-scale riots too.」

stage0057_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Seems we've reached the point of no return...
　...Any word on $$カグラ$$'s whereabouts?」

stage0057_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
Altair Soldier
「My apologies.
　It remains unknown.」

stage0057_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$イズモ$$
「$$ミカゲ$$ is likely pulling the strings.
　That man cares nothing for Altair's future...」

stage0057_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$イズモ$$
「But even so, he's found us a lead
　on the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$...」

stage0057_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$イズモ$$
「Prepare $$アフラ・グニス$$ for launch.」

stage0057_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$イズモ$$
「I will go to Vega.
　It seems the time has come to taste
　the battlefield air I've long been away from.」

stage0057_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$イズモ$$
（$$アリシア$$...
　To make this world's birth cry ring out again,
　I will surely find the true Eve...）

stage0057_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$イズモ$$
（Perhaps I'll even get to meet
　the son you left behind on Vega...）

stage0057_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$$クラン$$
「You're a bother, $$アンディ$$!
　Sulk in your own room if you're gonna sulk!」

stage0057_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$スズネ$$
「With our mood-maker $$アンディ$$ like that,
　the whole squad's feeling down.」

stage0057_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Still, this can't go on like this...」

stage0057_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Oh, n-no! It's nothing...!
　I wonder what's gotten into him...」

stage0057_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$モロイ$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$, where's $c
　headed right now?」

stage0057_03:r_0827963cfd706e8d.text:
$$スズネ$$
「The $$プラント$$s of the L5 sector.」

stage0057_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Space colonies where Coordinators live, huh.」

stage0057_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$スズネ$$
「They're officially neutral, but
　slowly leaning toward Neo Zeon.」

stage0057_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$モロイ$$
「I see...
　So we're heading there to investigate.」

stage0057_03:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$カイエン$$
「By the way, how's $$ゼシカ$$ doing?」

stage0057_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Training in the hangar with $n's group.」

stage0057_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「That's obviously going to end up
　as overtraining!」

stage0057_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$リディ$$
「$$ゼシカ$$, $n.
　That wraps up the special program.」

stage0057_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$シン$$
「You've gotten better, $n.
　In the Grade III simulation,
　you finally topped a 70 percent kill rate.」

stage0057_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$n
「Still, I've got a long way to go
　before I can really master GAI Mode.」

stage0057_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$キラ$$
「Good work, $$ゼシカ$$, too.
　Keeping up with $n's training,
　you're pushing yourself too hard.」

stage0057_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「I remembered something.
　That I'm... a woman who fights...」

stage0057_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Lately it's felt uncertain, but
　I don't want to lose that strength...」

stage0057_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$キラ$$
「Sure, you're a great pilot, but
　before that, you're just you.」

stage0057_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$キラ$$
「Whether you fight or not, you're you.
　So don't push yourself.」

stage0057_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Thanks, $$キラ$$...
　That's... made me feel a bit better.」

stage0057_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$シン$$
「Just go to sleep already.
　Rest your mind along with your body.」

stage0057_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$シン$$
「Turn into a training nut like $n
　and you'll be fighting in your dreams too.」

stage0057_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「$$アンディ$$'s already a mess,
　what'll we do if you collapse too?」

stage0057_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「It's the class president's job.
　Don't make me fuss over you.」

stage0057_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「Ugh, come on! It's not like that!」

stage0057_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ＭＩＸ$$
「W-what?! Why's everyone
　giving me that knowing look?!」

stage0057_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$シン$$
「Say what you will, but $$ＭＩＸ$$...
　really looks out for people.」

stage0057_03:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$キラ$$
「Given time, I bet $$アンディ$$
　will come around too.」

stage0057_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$n
「$$ゼシカ$$'s the real problem, though.
　Seems like it's pretty serious.」

stage0057_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$リディ$$
「Guess she's still hung up on $$アマタ$$...」

stage0057_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$キラ$$
「Still, it's not like $$アマタ$$ did anything wrong.」

stage0057_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$シン$$
「True...
　But when no one's really to blame,
　it's hard when feelings have nowhere to go.」

stage0057_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$リディ$$
「I hope she doesn't just sink
　into sadness like this...」

stage0057_03:r_fb05d8e5f1ee93e5.text:
$$シン$$
「So that doesn't happen, let's all
　of us, not just $$ＭＩＸ$$, work together
　to cheer $$ゼシカ$$ up!」

stage0057_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$リディ$$
「How about this?
　What if you filled the gap $$アマタ$$ left
　in $$ゼシカ$$'s heart?」

stage0057_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$リディ$$
「You got a problem with that?
　$$ゼシカ$$'s healthy and cute.」

stage0057_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$キラ$$
「You gotta say it out loud, $$シン$$.
　'I already have a girlfriend...'」

stage0057_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$キラ$$
「$$シン$$'s been fired up since yesterday
　because he gets to see her at the $$プラント$$s.」

stage0057_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$n
「Now that I think of it, $$カミーユ$$ said the same.」

stage0057_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$リディ$$
「You're a sly one too, $$シン$$.」

stage0057_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$シン$$
「What about you, $$キラ$$?
　Aren't you happy to see $$ラクス$$?」

stage0057_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$リディ$$
「Hold on!
　That Lacus... the $$プラント$$'s songstress,
　$$ラクス・クライン$$...!?」

stage0057_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$リディ$$
「No way...
　I... I was a fan...」

stage0057_03:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$n
「But I'm surprised too...
　that she's $$キラ$$'s girlfriend...」

stage0057_03:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$$シン$$
「What are you talking about, $n?
　You've got that rumored nurse of yours.」

stage0057_03:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$リディ$$
「Ah, to be young!
　Living the youth life!」

stage0057_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$n
「$$シン$$ mentioned it before, but
　$$ラクス$$ was part of $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ too, right?」

stage0057_03:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$キラ$$
「Yeah.
　Right now she's working in the $$プラント$$s
　to try and stop the war.」

stage0057_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$シン$$
「The $$多元戦争$$ should've taught the $$プラント$$s
　their lesson too. I doubt they'll act rash.」

stage0057_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$キラ$$
（What is it...
　that heavy feeling surrounding the $$プラント$$s...）

stage0057_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「The council's over, but you were so late
　I came to fetch you.」

stage0057_03:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「From the look of it, things aren't going well...」

stage0057_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ラクス$$
「The Council's support for Neo Zeon
　can't be stopped anymore, it seems.」

stage0057_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ラクス$$
「That's less about expanding Spacenoid rights
　than an outlet for emotion...」

stage0057_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「《$$パトリック・ザラ$$》's curse still hasn't faded, hm...」

stage0057_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$ラクス$$
「Even though two great $$時空震動$$s changed the
　world, wounds in people's hearts remain unhealed.」

stage0057_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「But this recent tilt toward Neo Zeon
　feels a bit abnormal to me.」

stage0057_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$メイリン$$
「Could this be Lieutenant $$クワトロ$$'s...
　influence, $$シャア・アズナブル$$'s...?」

stage0057_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「I do recognize that man's strength.」

stage0057_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「But the history of war between $$プラント$$ and Earth
　means a conflict between Coordinators and Naturals.
　In other words, it's a conflict of species.」

stage0057_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「There's no reason for ideological sympathy
　with Neo Zeon, yet emotion is all that shows.
　As if they're riding the tide of war on purpose...」

stage0057_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ラクス$$
「...Any word from $$アスラン$$ and the others?」

stage0057_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$メイリン$$
「So far, nothing notable seems to have turned up.」

stage0057_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「$$アスラン$$ and $$ルナマリア$$ are
　investigating the Council's secret ties
　to Neo Zeon right now...」

stage0057_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「If they can turn up something, we might
　be able to stop this abnormal tide.」

stage0057_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ラクス$$
「For now, all we can do is wait for them.」

stage0057_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「The $$大統領$$ of the Earth Federation went to
　the trouble of sharing everything on $$エタニティ・フラット$$,
　yet the mood here is still sour.」

stage0057_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ラクス$$
「A little over two months left...
　It will be a trial for all humanity.」

stage0057_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「If we're still fighting a war by then,
　humanity's history ending would be no surprise.」

stage0057_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「That was a poor joke to make, even as a joke.
　I'm sorry, $$メイリン$$.」

stage0057_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ラクス$$
「With so little time left, we can only do so much.」

stage0057_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「$c is doing their best too.
　Let's give it our all as well.」

stage0057_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$メイリン$$
「Vajra are approaching $$プラント$$!
　$$ザフト$$ has scrambled to intercept, they say!」

stage0057_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「As if the war weren't trouble enough,
　now things like that show up too!」

stage0057_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$プラント$$ refused us port, you say...!?」

stage0057_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$メラン$$
「Apparently, from a neutral stance, they don't
　want to side with the Federation or Neo Zeon.」

stage0057_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Sophistry...!
　After wagging their tail at Neo Zeon!」

stage0057_03:r_e598c2a0b27e7f50.text:
$$ブライト$$
「Have they forgotten that we drove off
　the Vajra and the Altair forces!」

stage0057_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$アムロ$$
「I didn't realize $$プラント$$ had leaned
　this far pro-Neo Zeon...」

stage0057_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ブライト$$
「...Forcing the issue here would only
　provoke them. We'll have to withdraw.」

stage0057_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$アムロ$$
「Even without resupply, following $$キラ$$
　and $$シン$$'s contacts, we can check on $$プラント$$.」

stage0057_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ブライト$$
「The problem is $$ＭＩＸ$$, taken by Altair.」

stage0057_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$メラン$$
「The Vector Siron she was piloting was found,
　but the cockpit was empty.」

stage0057_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$アムロ$$
「All that interests them is a female Element...
　Or in their words, the strongest $$レア・イグラー$$.」

stage0057_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$ブライト$$
「So this is the result of trying to get
　dimensional transfer technology...」

stage0057_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$チェーン$$
「They all seem to be in shock, to a one.」

stage0057_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$アムロ$$
「But since we can't resupply at $$プラント$$,
　we need to hurry and get out of here.」

stage0057_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$メラン$$
「Worn down as we are from today's battle,
　Neo Zeon's pursuers won't leave us be.」

stage0057_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$ブライト$$
「$$フル・フロンタル$$...
　So he's coming, is he...」

stage0057_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$アンディ$$
「If you hadn't flinched back then, $$ＭＩＸ$$ would...!」

stage0057_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$アルト$$
「Stop it, $$アンディ$$!
　That wasn't $$アマタ$$'s fault!」

stage0057_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Let go, $$アルト$$!
　Why... Why didn't you save $$ＭＩＸ$$!」

stage0057_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$ミコノ$$
「$$アンディ$$!
　You don't have to say it like that!」

stage0057_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Do you, who couldn't even sortie,
　have any right to blame $$アマタ$$?」

stage0057_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「Sorry, $$アンディ$$...
　It's because I sent $$ＭＩＸ$$ out to fight...」

stage0057_03:r_6d77e72dbbcd7dfe.text:
$$シン$$
「We fought to protect $$プラント$$, yet...!
　Why did it have to come to this...!」

stage0057_03:r_0cea115be526a319.text:
$n
「Don't take your anger out on the wrong person, $$アンディ$$.」

stage0057_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$n
「What you should be doing is saving $$ＭＩＸ$$!
　Don't go despairing on your own!」

stage0057_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$アンディ$$
「If there were a way, I'd have done it
　already! But unless the dimensional gate
　opens, we can't chase after them!!」

stage0057_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「A dimensional gate...
　So it's a transfer, then...」

stage0057_03:r_42a3149105314ab8.text:
$$バナージ$$
「If that were possible, even
　$$エタニティ・フラット$$ could be...」

stage0057_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
$n
「We'll save $$ＭＩＸ$$,
　we won't let humanity's history end,
　and we won't forgive $$ガドライト$$...」

stage0057_03:r_2c7af4c55d8ac938.text:
$n
「There's only one thing we need to do.」

stage0057_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$n
「If we take them down, that solves everything, right?」

stage0057_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「We have to do all of that.」

stage0057_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$キラ$$
「Let's do it, $$アンディ$$.
　It's not all over yet.」

stage0057_03:r_ef16bcaa2b0e0c45.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Like I can just switch my feelings that easily...!」

stage0057_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$n
「Then go bury yourself in a hole,
　alone, for the rest of your life.」

stage0057_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$ユノハ$$
「Please fight, $$アンディ$$...!
　Please save the one you love, no matter what!」

stage0057_03:r_ad3e1db3419665fb.text:
$$キラ$$
「$$アンディ$$...
　I've also lost someone dear right before my eyes...」

stage0057_03:r_3ad10e705167a3fa.text:
$$キラ$$
「Even now... I still dream about it...
　So I don't want you to feel that way too...」

stage0057_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$カイエン$$
「Where do you plan to go?」

stage0057_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Just let me be alone for a bit.」

stage0057_03:r_ffae76d2a77abf5a.text:
$n
「That guy isn't the type to stay stuck in a hole.」

stage0057_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$バナージ$$
（The pain of losing someone precious...
　Everyone here has lived through that...）

stage0057_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$カミーユ$$
「Better to leave her alone for now, I'd think.」

stage0057_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$シン$$
「Will she be able to bounce back?」

stage0057_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「So uncool...
　I'm way too lame...」

stage0057_03:r_0b3b19cddb871f90.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「$$アマタ$$ should have just left
　someone like me and saved $$ＭＩＸ$$ instead...」

stage0057_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$ゼシカ$$
「If I'm not the one you chose,
　being here just makes me miserable...!」

stage0057_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「Because you and I are both unchosen, the same...」

stage0057_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「You, unchosen, already know.
　Even if you cling to a hand offered
　in jest, it's easily shaken off...」

stage0057_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「As for me, I could tear off the hand
　I offer you, just like that.」

stage0057_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「I'll grant your wish...
　I'll open the dimensional gate for you.」

stage0057_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ミカゲ$$
「In exchange, I want a promise from you too.」

stage0057_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm way too pathetic, damn it!
　Moping on my own, dragging everyone down,
　and then taking it out on them, on top of it!!」

stage0057_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$アンディ$$
「I'm an idiot, a fool!
　A worthless bum good for nothing but digging holes!!」

stage0057_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$アンディ$$
「A guy like this isn't worthy of $$ＭＩＸ$$!!」

stage0057_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$アンディ$$
「$$ＭＩＸ$$... I refuse to say goodbye like this...
　I still... I still haven't held you close...
　Not that Big Bang of yours...!」

stage0057_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Daaaamn it!
　I'm the worst, at a time like this!
　Damn me! What the hell is wrong with me!」

stage0057_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$アンディ$$
「Die, me!
　Damn it! Damn it! Daaaamn it!!」

stage0057_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
（Go ahead and let it out, Master $$アンディ$$.
　There's no one here to see.）

stage0057_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
